narrative.overview:
HourDen is a private workshop for freelancers who turn tracked time into Sent invoices. The visual world is a warm dark den: ember light for anything live and earning, quiet hairlines for the ledger of the month, and Project color only for categorization — never competing with the brand accent. Hierarchy comes from type scale and spacing, not nested boxes.

This file records the ADR-0015 Warm Den target (accepted direction). Shipped CSS may still show the cooler blue ADR-0012 palette until issue #189 lands; agents implementing foundation and polish tickets treat this document — not the interim blue tokens — as normative.
keyCharacteristics: Warm near-black surfaces; ember as the single brand/live accent
Hairline-separated rows; borders reserved for inputs, overlays, timer bar, Invoice preview
Money beside time at equal weight; tabular numerals as the visual anchor
Wide desktop Tracker; readable column on form-heavy screens
Flat tonal depth — no ambient card shadows

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember marks live/earning/primary action only. Settled amounts, chips, and charts stay content, muted, or Project color.

rules.name: The Fewer Boxes Rule
rules.body: Prefer hairline rows on background over bordered surface cards. Borders stay on inputs, overlays, the timer bar, and the Invoice preview.

rules.name: The Numbers Lead Rule
rules.body: Duration and money use the numeric face at content weight; never bury amounts as tiny muted footnotes when they sit beside time.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No card drop shadows. If a shadow appears, it is a state response (focus attention), not resting structure.

dos: Do use ember for Running Timer, live earnings, and primary actions only.
Do put amounts beside durations with tabular numerals.
Do separate list rows with hairlines on the page background.
Do mark Projects with a swatch/dot and use Project colors in the Day Ribbon and stacked charts.
Do keep Invoice preview and inputs as bordered surfaces.
donts: Don't use progress rings, donuts, or sparklines as readiness costume.
Don't ship hero-metric KPI card strips (big number + small label + delta) as page structure.
Don't use a >1px colored border-left / border-right on rows or cards.
Don't paint settled money or chart series in ember.
Don't restore green as the running accent.
Don't load display fonts from a third-party CDN — self-host only.
